config.ueVersion.desc: Preferred Unreal Engine version (e.g., 5.4). Empty = latest detected.
config.clangdPath.desc: Path to clangd binary. Empty = auto-detect.
config.autoBackupWorkspace.desc: Auto-backup and restore .code-workspace against UBT refresh.
config.editorAwareBuild.desc: Before a build, detect a running Unreal Editor and suggest Live Coding instead (avoids DLL lock errors).
config.scaffold.clangFormat.desc: Create Unreal Clangd Project: also scaffold a base .clang-format (never overwrites an existing one).
config.scaffold.clangTidy.desc: Create Unreal Clangd Project: also scaffold a base .clang-tidy (never overwrites an existing one).
config.progressLocation.desc: Where task progress is shown. window = status bar spinner (auto-hides when done, no popup); notification = bottom-right popup.
config.progressLocation.enum.0: Status bar spinner — auto-hides when the task finishes, no popup
config.useMCP.desc: MCP server mode. Auto = enable only in Cursor/Claude Code.
config.clangdProxy.enabled.desc: Enable clangd LSP proxy with didClose keepalive and localization.
config.clangdProxy.keepaliveMax.desc: Maximum number of keepalive documents. Invalid values clamp to 20.
config.clangdProxy.keepaliveTtlSec.desc: Keepalive TTL in seconds. Invalid values clamp to 900.
config.clangdProxy.realClangdPath.desc: Path to the real clangd binary. Empty = auto-detect.
config.clangdProxy.logPath.desc: Log file path for the proxy. Empty = no file logging (stderr only).
config.clangdProxy.localization.mode.des: Localization mode: append = add Chinese after English, zh-only = Chinese only.
config.clangdProxy.dictionaryPath.desc: Path to UE docs dictionary JSON file for hover localization. Empty = disabled.
config.showPerfInStatusBar.desc: Show performance metrics (compile_commands gen time, preparse cache hit rate, incremental scan latency) in status bar.
config.clangd.userAddFlags.desc:
## Custom Add Flags

勾选要写入 `.clangd` `CompileFlags.Add` 的 flag id。**默认空数组 = Add 完全为空(系统零默认注入)**。需要默认 flag 时,请在面板中显式勾选,或运行 `Set System Includes` 让 SDK flag 自动加入。

**id 含义**
- `compat-header` —— 强制包含 UE Clangd 兼容头 (/FI<ueClangdCompat.h>)
- `macro-helper` —— 强制包含宏补全 helper
- `std-cxx20` —— C++20 标准
- `preparse-headers` —— 预解析 SharedPCH + addMacroCompletions.h
- `uht-include-dirs` —— UHT 生成头目录 (/I)
- `system-include-windows` —— Windows SDK / MSVC (/X /imsvc /fms-compatibility-version),由 `Set System Includes` 命令管理
